what_is_it.explanation: Polars is an analytical query engine written in Rust that lets developers write queries using a DataFrame API, SQL, or a mix of both. It features multi-threaded, vectorized SIMD execution, Apache Arrow columnar format for zero-copy data sharing, and can spill to disk when operations exceed RAM.
